 College basketball schedule for Tuesday: Illinois-Duke headlines an incredible day of college hoops 
 Illinois visits Duke, Michigan State travels to Tennessee and the Players Era 8 tips off in Las Vegas on a spectacular Tuesday of college basketball. By Rodney Knuppel | Nov 17, 2026, 3:30 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Andrej Stojakovic | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect If college basketball fans needed another reason to get excited about the opening month of the season, Tuesday's schedule should provide it. Several of the nation's most recognizable programs will be in action, including a spectacular meeting between Illinois and Duke at Cameron Indoor Stadium. Michigan State travels to Tennessee, Arkansas faces Indiana at Madison Square Garden and the Players Era 8 gets underway in Las Vegas.
--> If college basketball fans needed another reason to get excited about the opening month of the season, Tuesday's schedule should provide it. Several of the nation's most recognizable programs will be in action, including a spectacular meeting between Illinois and Duke at Cameron Indoor Stadium. Michigan State travels to Tennessee, Arkansas faces Indiana at Madison Square Garden and the Players Era 8 gets underway in Las Vegas.
 The action begins well before the traditional evening television window, with Houston and Rutgers meeting at 2 p.m. ET. From there, college basketball fans will have nationally televised games available throughout the afternoon, evening and into the early hours of Wednesday morning.
--> The action begins well before the traditional evening television window, with Houston and Rutgers meeting at 2 p.m. ET. From there, college basketball fans will have nationally televised games available throughout the afternoon, evening and into the early hours of Wednesday morning.
 The Players Era 8 gets underway in Las Vegas
--> The Players Era 8 gets underway in Las Vegas
 The Michelob ULTRA Arena will host four intriguing quarterfinal games Tuesday, beginning with Houston and Rutgers. Florida subsequently faces Notre Dame, providing the Fighting Irish with an opportunity to deliver one of the most significant upsets of the young season.
--> The Michelob ULTRA Arena will host four intriguing quarterfinal games Tuesday, beginning with Houston and Rutgers. Florida subsequently faces Notre Dame, providing the Fighting Irish with an opportunity to deliver one of the most significant upsets of the young season.
 Kansas and UNLV meet during the evening window, while West Virginia and Auburn close the opening day shortly before midnight Eastern time. The tournament provides several programs with opportunities to strengthen their early-season resumes before conference competition begins.
--> Kansas and UNLV meet during the evening window, while West Virginia and Auburn close the opening day shortly before midnight Eastern time. The tournament provides several programs with opportunities to strengthen their early-season resumes before conference competition begins.
 Illinois and Duke headline a spectacular evening
--> Illinois and Duke headline a spectacular evening
 Cameron Indoor Stadium will provide the setting for one of November's most anticipated games when Illinois visits Duke . Both programs entered the season with substantial expectations, and Tuesday's meeting offers an early opportunity to evaluate their national championship potential.
--> Cameron Indoor Stadium will provide the setting for one of November's most anticipated games when Illinois visits Duke . Both programs entered the season with substantial expectations, and Tuesday's meeting offers an early opportunity to evaluate their national championship potential.
 Michigan State and Tennessee provide another outstanding nonconference attraction later in the evening. Meanwhile, Arkansas and Indiana meet at Madison Square Garden in a game featuring two programs with considerable basketball tradition.
--> Michigan State and Tennessee provide another outstanding nonconference attraction later in the evening. Meanwhile, Arkansas and Indiana meet at Madison Square Garden in a game featuring two programs with considerable basketball tradition.
 Several mid-major games deserve attention
--> Several mid-major games deserve attention
 Southern Illinois and Liberty meet on a neutral floor in Charlotte, while unbeaten UC Irvine travels to Stanford for its first road game of the season. Montana State's visit to Gonzaga provides another interesting late-night option for fans looking beyond the marquee national games.

 Tuesday offers nearly an entire day of meaningful college basketball. With Feast Week approaching, the nonconference schedule is beginning to deliver the kind of entertainment fans have been anticipating since April.
